§9EIGHT STEPS, AND EVERY ONE OF THEM IS A REAL UNIT OPERATION.§r
This is hydrometallurgy as it is actually done. It is long, it is mostly EV, and it ends at the yellow powder every uranium mine on earth ships.

§5§l1. §lCOMMINUTION§r §8- Ore Milling Plant (IsaMill), HV, 20 s§r
 §2 16x Uraninite Dust + 1x Alumina Milling Ball + circuit 1  ->  16x Milled Uraninite§r
  §8Or 12x Pitchblende Dust on circuit 2 - the richer ore buys the same sixteen.§r
  §1The Alumina Milling Ball is part of the RECIPE, and it is also NOT consumed.§r §8Both are true: the recipe has to name a ball or the IsaMill returns NO RECIPE and never starts, and the physical ball is then taken from the mill's Milling Ball hatch and worn down a point at a time. So stock the ball bus as usual - just do not be surprised to see the ball on the NEI page. Every milling step in this mod uses the ALUMINA ball: this one, the MOX and thorium co-milling, and the propellant powder alike.§r

§52. FROTH FLOTATION§r §8- Flotation Cell, EV, 30 s§r
  first:§2 2x Soda Ash + circuit 4 + 1,000 L Pine Oil  ->  1x Froth Cell§r §8(Mixer, MV)§r
  then: §2 16x Milled Uraninite + 1x Froth Cell + 8,000 L Water  ->  8,000 L Uraninite Flotation Froth§r
  then: §2 8,000 L Froth + circuit 1  ->  12x Concentrate + 4x Tailings + 2x Gangue + 3,000 L Water back§r §8(Dehydrator)§r
  §8The cell emits a FLUID, not a solid - it has no item output slot at all, which is how GT++'s own sphalerite line works too. The third step is where the solids come back and where the barren rock leaves.§r

§53. SULFURIC LEACH§r §8- Digester, EV, 40 s§r
 §2 12x Concentrate + 2x Pyrolusite Dust + circuit 1 + 6,000 L Sulfuric Acid  ->  8,000 L Pregnant Leach Solution + 3x Leach Residue§r

§54-6. CLEAN-UP AND SOLVENT EXTRACTION§r §8- Chemical Plant t2 then t3, EV/IV§r
 §2 8,000 L PLS + 1x Ion Exchange Resin  ->  6,000 L Clarified Uranyl + 2,000 L Raffinate§r §8(resin returns 90% of the time)§r
 §2 6,000 L Clarified + 2,000 L TBP/Kerosene  ->  4,000 L Loaded Organic + 2,000 L Raffinate§r
 §2 4,000 L Loaded Organic + 4x Soda Ash + 2,000 L Water  ->  3,000 L Strip Liquor + 1,800 L TBP back§r
  §8Tributyl phosphate in kerosene is the extractant every real uranium refinery uses, and you make it yourself (look up TBP/Kerosene Solvent in NEI). 1,800 of the 2,000 L come back, so the running cost is 200 L of make-up.§r

§57-8. PRECIPITATE AND CALCINE§r §8- LCR then Dehydrator, HV/EV§r
 §2 3,000 L Strip Liquor + 1,000 L Ammonia  ->  6x Ammonium Diuranate + 1,000 L Ammonium Sulfate Liquor§r
 §2 6x Ammonium Diuranate  ->  4x YELLOWCAKE + 500 L Ammonia back§r

[warn]§cPlumb the Ammonium Sulfate Liquor or your line will stall.§r§9 1,000 L Ammonium Sulfate Liquor§r is a co-product with nowhere else to go, and §9a GT machine whose output hatch is full STOPS§r. Run it through a Distillation Tower -§2 300 L Ammonia back + 400 L Diluted Sulfuric Acid§r - or give it a void hatch.[/warn]

[note]Nothing here is waste for the sake of it. Gangue, tailings and leach residue each have a cheap Centrifuge recipe, and the §9tailings give back Uraninite at 33%§r - a real scavenger circuit.[/note]

[note]§1The headline number:§r§9 16x Uraninite Dust in at step 1 is one Uranium Fuel Rod out§r, at Grade 1 purified water. The next two quests are why.[/note]
